costs = [num('Allowed assignments', f'N{r}') for r in rows]
data = list(zip(tasks, workers, costs))
all_tasks = list(set(t[0] for t in data))
all_workers = list(set(t[1] for t in data))
min_cost = 999999
for p in itertools.permutations(all_workers, len(all_tasks)):
    cost_sum = 0
    valid = True
    for t, w in zip(all_tasks, p):
        match = [c for task, worker, c in data if task == t and worker == w]
        if match:
            cost_sum += match[0]
        else:
            valid = False
            break
    if valid and cost_sum < min_cost:
        min_cost = cost_sum
result = int(min_cost)

sheet = 'Allowed assignments'
rows_idx = range(812, 821)
tasks = [cell(sheet, f'L{r}') for r in rows_idx]
workers = [cell(sheet, f'M{r}') for r in rows_idx]
costs = [num(sheet, f'N{r}') for r in rows_idx]

data = list(zip(tasks, workers, costs))
unique_tasks = list(set(t[0] for t in data))
unique_workers = list(set(t[1] for t in data))

best_cost = float('inf')
best_assignment = None

for p in itertools.permutations(unique_workers, len(unique_tasks)):
    current_cost = 0
    valid = True
    mapping = dict(zip(unique_tasks, p))
    for t, w, c in data:
        if mapping.get(t) == w:
            current_cost += c
    if current_cost < best_cost:
        best_cost = current_cost
        best_assignment = mapping

result = best_assignment['Pack']

rows = data_rows('Allowed assignments', {'L': 'string', 'M': 'string', 'N': 'number'}, 812, 820)
tasks = list(set(cell('Allowed assignments', f'L{r}') for r in rows))
workers = list(set(cell('Allowed assignments', f'M{r}') for r in rows))
cost_map = {(cell('Allowed assignments', f'L{r}'), cell('Allowed assignments', f'M{r}')): num('Allowed assignments', f'N{r}') for r in rows}
best_cost = float('inf')
unused_worker = None
for perm in itertools.permutations(workers, len(tasks)):
    current_cost = sum(cost_map.get((tasks[i], perm[i]), float('inf')) for i in range(len(tasks)))
    if current_cost < best_cost:
        best_cost = current_cost
        assigned_workers = set(perm)
        unused_worker = list(set(workers) - assigned_workers)[0]
result = unused_worker
